content: 109 of 210  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 12: AUTOSAR_SWS_CANInterface Specification of CAN Interface AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Service Name CanIf_CurrentIcomConfiguration Syntax void CanIf_CurrentIcomConfiguration ( uint8 ControllerId, IcomConfigIdType ConfigurationId, IcomSwitch_ErrorType Error ) Service ID [hex] 0x26 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant only for different controller Ids ControllerId Abstract CanIf ControllerId which is assigned to a CAN controller, which informs about the Configuration Id. ConfigurationId Active Configuration Id. Parameters (in) Error ICOM_SWITCH_E_OK: No Error ICOM_SWITCH_E_FAILED: Switch to requested Configuration failed. Severe Error. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description This service shall inform about the change of the Icom Configuration of a CAN controller using the abstract CanIf ControllerId. Available via CanIf_Can.h
